# Link icon fixture

`social-github.svg` is a copy of brunosouzas.com `public/images/home/social-github.svg` at commit `e29b3dd` (published site asset). `test/pieces/icons.test.ts` reads it to check that `linkIcon`'s GitHub glyph keeps the site's path.

The GitHub mark in it is from Font Awesome (fontawesome.com), licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
